quadrant_rule: red = level>= 1.00% AND deteriorating (>= +25% rel and >= +0.10pp abs over ~12m), or any RBI action-zone breach; orange = level >= 1.00%, or deteriorating from >= 0.25%, or market DD < 1; yellow = deteriorating, or level >= 0.25%, or a funding flag, or a forensic indicator, or market DD < 2; green = none of the above
method_note: One row per institution with a fresh vetted public dossier (nothing older than 24 months is presented as current; failed institutions are replayed on the Evidence tab instead). Components are validated independently on the 48-institution record and fused only for presentation — the tier is a published rule over published components. PD levels are corpus-fitted and prior-corrected to a ~0.25%/yr population base rate (King-Zeng); the Merton PD is a market repricing signal, not a calibrated failure frequency. Institutions without vetted dossiers are absent by design: nothing here is scored from memory.
